headline: ADVENTURE's doorways become hardware-exact
lede: The seam that lets a dragon chase you between rooms used an approximation of the doorway. Now it is the 1979 law: only a dragon whose body actually overlaps the opening follows you through — the strip of stone beside the door is stone again.

notes.text: #3552: seam-follow admits a hunter only when its 10×10 sprite rect genuinely overlaps the doorway rect (both axes) — anchor-only followers that phase-followed through solid wall beside the door are gone; +7 boundary pins and a slack-regression mutant prove it

Picker audit shipped with the fix: ADVENTURE scored weakest on 13 README 'gaps' — nine were restored-feature bullets parsed from inside the section, two were shipped notes; the shelf board sees the honest 1 gap (the gate-rite manual) now
adventurecheck 223/0, all 60 mutants die, advedrive 10/10 in real Chrome with zero page errors, seed pins unmoved (feedbackcheck 291/291)
Red-main freeze held the merge: the nightly attractcheck red was fixed by #3557's GALAGA re-pin — verified locally, rebased on it, merged after the fresh nightly confirmed green

look.text: ADVENTURE — run for the door with a dragon at your heels: does it fit?
